name: Whoopie Pies
creator: Melissa Waterhouse
ingredients: 1 Cup packed (7 oz) light brown sugar
instructions: **For the Cakes adjust the oven racks to the upper-middle and lower-middle positions and heat the oven to 350*. Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Whisk the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt together in a medium bowl.  In a large bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar together with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, 3 to 6 minutes. Beat in egg and vanilla until combined, about 30 seconds, scraping down the bowl and beaters as necessary. Reduce the mixer speed to low and slowly mix in half of the flour mixture, followed by half of the buttermilk. Repeat with half of the remaining flour mixture, and the remaining buttermilk. Mix until combined. Scoop generous 1/4 Cup mounds of batter on the prepared baking sheets, spaced about 2 inches apart. Bake the cakes until they spring back when pressed, 15-18 minutes, switching and rotating the baking sheets halfway through the baking. Let the cakes cool completely on the baking sheets, about 1 hour. **For the Filling Beat the butter and confectioners sugar together in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Beat in the vanilla and salt. Beat in the marshmallow creme until incorporated, about 2 minutes. To serve, spread 1/3 cup of the filling evenly over the bottom of a cake then make another sandwich by pressing the bottom of another cake onto the filling, repeat with the remaining cakes and filling.

name: Ceviche
creator: Neen Reynolds
ingredients: 1.5 lb mahi mahi cubed (can use any white fresh fish)
3/4 cup Coconut canned unsweetened milk (might separate a little but that's ok)
Plantain Chips (Chile's brand Tostones Brand are nice)
instructions: The day before, combine fish, mango, papaya, red onion, bell pepper, cilantro stems, jalapeño, lime zest, lime juice, rice vinegar, coconut milk and (liberal) salt to plastic bag. The smaller the pieces of fish are, the faster they will cook. Shake a few times, and then lay flat in the fridge overnight. The bag should lay flat to ensure that liquid touches every part of the fish to cook it. The next day, or once the fish is cooked, remove bag from fridge and place in serving dish. Salt again and taste. Adjust flavors accordingly. Top with Wasabi micro greens, green onion curls*, and marigold. *Green onion curls: Slice green onion in half lengthwise and place in cold water. They should immediately curl up.

name: Beet Salad
creator: Fernanda Tapia
instructions: **Beets** Place beets, salt and vinegar in a pot and fill with water. Let boil, and turn down to medium. Check them 30 min later with a fork. When knife or fork can go in easily, remove from water. Let cool for 5 minutes and then peel/remove skin (wear gloves) Cut into 3/4 inch cubes. **Tarragon Vinaigrette Dressing** Add shallot, honey, vinegar, Canola oil, water and salt to blender. Blend until creamy and thick (almost like a milkshake) Add Tarragon and blend until green. **Pistachios** Pre-heat oven to 350 degree. Roast pistachios on 350 degrees until golden brown. LET COOL COMPLETELY Add pistachios, healthy pinch of salt, and 1 Tbsp sugar. Pulse 5 or 6 times...then taste for seasoning (should be sweet with a hint of saltiness). May need a bit more salt. Then chop more until chunky (not powder). **Dress and Garnish** Dress beets (add enough dressing to coat beets. Pinch of salt. Top with crushed pistachios. Top with shaved shallots. Top with cilantro leaves

name: Zucchini and Saffron Risotto
creator: Milk Street Meditrannean Cook Book
ingredients: 2 fresno chilles (or 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes)
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine 4 cups water, the orange zest, saffron, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium-high, then cover and reduce to low to keep warm.

name: Jackfruit Tacos
creator: Neen Reynolds
ingredients: 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded, deveined and quartered (optional!)
instructions:
Liberally apply blackening blend to jackfruit. Salt at the beginning to release moisture, apply salt again later near the end. H

Heat a bit of cooking oil to mice and hot. Add jackfruit to the pan and let some of the juice start to reduce. Cook until gets nice and crispy. Taste Taste Taste. Take a few handfuls of sauce to the jackfruit. Put more sauce on top of it inside the taco. 

**Papaya barbecue sauce:**
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat, and add in the onion. Cook, until the onions are translucent, stirring continuously to ensure the pieces do not brown

Sprinkle the sugar, scotch bonnet lime zest, and lemon zest over the onions, and stir until the sugar dissolves. Pour in the lime juice, lemon juice, water and vinegar. Bring the ingredients to a boil. Add in the diced papaya, and adjust the seasonings with the salt, if desired.

Bring the mixture to a boil again, reduce the heat, and allow the mixture to simmer for 15 minutes. Take the pan off the heat, and let the mixture cool slightly. Carefully transfer the mixture to a blender, and puree the sauce until smooth.

**Building the taco**

_Pineapple_
Slice Pineapple into long thin pieces, and cover in paprika and chili powder. Place in ziplock and add lemon juice. Allow to marinate for 1.5 hours. Take pineapple out and place on grill for a few minutes.
